review_method: Rendered Apple HIG pages were matched to canonical rules by official URL, section path, source hash, and source sentence hash; surrounding guidance was reviewed without persisting full source prose.

decision_policy.must: Retain MUST for an unqualified Always, Ensure, Make sure, Must, or You must directive after checking its surrounding conditions and exceptions. Preserve accessibility, privacy, safety, security, user-intent, and platform-contract requirements at MUST.
decision_policy.must_not: Retain MUST_NOT for an explicit Never, must not, or Always avoid prohibition after checking its surrounding conditions and exceptions.
decision_policy.mixed_strength: Split or narrow a candidate when mandatory and optional clauses occur in the same source lead; do not promote consider guidance to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0010.title: Always display Activity rings on a black background

statement.en: Display Activity rings only on a black background.

conditions: Activity rings appear in the experience.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0013.title: Always scale Activity rings to remain visually connected and appropriately placed

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0035.title: Always require two confirmations before a difficult-to-recover action

statement.en: Require two confirmation steps before people perform an action that is difficult to recover from.

conditions: Assistive Access is enabled.
The action is difficult to recover from.
Apply within the accessibility and section context identified by the source trace.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0015.title: End a Live Activity immediately when its task or event ends

statement.en: End a Live Activity immediately when its task or event ends.
statement.ja: タスクまたはイベントが終了したら、Live Activityを直ちに終了する。

conditions: The task or event represented by the Live Activity has ended.
Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.
exceptions: Choosing a custom dismissal time is optional guidance and is represented by a separate MAY rule.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0015.review_note: Narrowed the MUST to the unqualified Always clause; the source lead's consider clause is split into a separate MAY rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0022.title: Maintain Live Activity contrast in Dark Mode and on reduced-luminance Always-On displays

statement.en: Keep Live Activity text, assets, and colors legible in Dark Mode and on reduced-luminance Always-On displays.
statement.ja: Dark Modeおよび低輝度の常時表示ディスプレイでも、Live Activityのテキスト、素材、色を判読可能に保つ。

conditions: The Live Activity appears in Dark Mode or on an Always-On display with reduced luminance.
Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0022.review_note: Restored the condition lost by the 19-word evidence-fragment limit; MUST is retained for legibility and contrast.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0002.review_note: Recorded the source's explicit modal-view exception without weakening the default requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0006.title: Ensure people receive critical information and can act when necessary

statement.en: Ensure people receive critical information and can act on it when necessary.
statement.ja: 重要な情報を確実に伝え、必要な場合はその情報に基づいて行動できるようにする。

conditions: The presented content contains critical information or requires a critical response.
Apply within the pattern and section context identified by the source trace.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0006.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Ensure directive in the modality context.

conditions: Review the unavailable and opt-out experience for the role generative AI plays in the product.

conditions: The experience uses implicit feedback or related behavioral signals.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0012.title: Make task completion clear to ResearchKit participants

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIGN-IN-WITH-APPLE-0017.title: Let people view their Sign in with Apple private relay address

conditions: The app or website uses a Sign in with Apple private relay address.
Apply within the technology and section context identified by the source trace.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIGN-IN-WITH-APPLE-0017.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Make sure directive in the data-collection guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-00.title: Keep Tap to Pay on iPhone available while configuration continues in the background

statement.en: Keep the Tap to Pay on iPhone checkout option available while configuration continues in the background.
statement.ja: バックグラウンドで設定が続いている間も、Tap to Pay on iPhoneのチェックアウトオプションを利用可能に保つ。

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0002.title: Make toggle states visually obvious

statement.en: Make each toggle state visually obvious without relying on color alone.
statement.ja: 色だけに依存せず、toggleの各状態を視覚的に明確にする。

conditions: Combine color with fill, shape, checkmark, dot, or another perceivable difference.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0002.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Make sure lead and its color-perception constraint.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0023.title: Require only one modifier key for a dynamic menu item

statement.en: Require exactly one modifier key to reveal a dynamic menu item.
statement.ja: dynamic menu itemの表示に必要なmodifier keyは1つだけにする。

conditions: Multiple keys reduce discoverability and can be physically awkward while choosing a menu item.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0023.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Require directive and its interaction-cost rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0024.title: Ensure full-screen iPad app functions remain accessible through the UI

statement.en: Ensure every iPad app function remains accessible through its UI when the full-screen menu bar is hidden.
statement.ja: full-screenでmenu barが隠れても、iPad appの全機能へUIからアクセスできるようにする。

conditions: Always provide another path for dynamic items available only with a hardware keyboard.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0024.review_note: Retained MUST after restoring the truncated explicit Ensure directive and reviewing the full-screen iPadOS context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0001.title: Adapt windows fluidly across supported sizes

statement.en: Ensure windows adapt fluidly across supported sizes for multitasking and multiwindow workflows.
statement.ja: multitaskingとmultiwindow workflowのため、windowを対応sizeへ滑らかに適応させる。

conditions: Support every window size available in the app's scoped platform context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0001.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Make sure lead and its multitasking and multiwindow scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0006.title: Prevent iPadOS window controls from overlapping toolbar items

statement.en: Ensure iPadOS window controls do not overlap toolbar items.
statement.ja: iPadOSのwindow controlがtoolbar itemと重ならないようにする。

conditions: In windowed mode, move leading toolbar buttons inward when window controls appear.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0006.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Make sure lead and the windowed-toolbar mitigation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0008.title: Match system-defined macOS window-state appearances

statement.en: Ensure custom macOS windows use the system-defined appearance for each window state.
statement.ja: custom macOS windowで各window stateのsystem-defined appearanceを使う。

conditions: Update custom backgrounds and controls when the window changes between main, key, and inactive states.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0008.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Make sure lead and state-dependent appearance requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0022.title: Support multiple iPadOS windows when presenting a single file

statement.en: Support multiple windows in an iPadOS app that presents a single file without creating a custom window.
statement.ja: custom windowを作らず単一fileを表示するiPadOS appでも、複数windowをsupportする。

conditions: The app presents one file without creating its own window.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0022.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit You must requirement from the official iPadOS Tip.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Display comfortable motion in a Full Space

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Request permission before accessing sensitive surroundings data

statement.ja: 周囲環境や手の位置に関するsensitive dataへアクセスする前に、permissionを求める。

conditions: The experience uses ARKit data to blend custom content with a person’s surroundings.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit You must permission requirement and its sensitive-data condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Clarify what an immersive-experience exit control does

statement.en: Make an exit control clarify whether it reduces immersion or quits the experience.
statement.ja: exit controlがimmersionを下げるのか体験を終了するのかを明確にする。

conditions: An immersive experience provides an exit control.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive while preserving the two distinct exit outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Never show excessive motion near the edges of the field of view

statement.en: Do not display excessive movement near the edges of a person’s field of view.
statement.ja: 利用者のfield of viewの端付近に過剰なmovementを表示しない。

conditions: The experience displays animation in a custom environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained MUST_NOT after confirming the explicit Always avoid directive.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Lower or stop the environmental soundscape when other audio plays

statement.en: Lower or stop the environmental soundscape when people can play other audio.
statement.ja: 利用者が別のaudioを再生できる場合、environmental soundscapeのvolumeを下げるか停止する。

conditions: People can play other audio while they use the environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure directive within its other-audio condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Always provide a ground plane in a custom environment

statement.en: Provide a ground plane mesh in a custom environment so people feel grounded.
statement.ja: 利用者がgroundedだと感じられるよう、custom environmentにground plane meshを設ける。

conditions: The app or game presents a custom environment in a Full Space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Always directive and its grounding purpose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0026.title: Support both landscape rotation directions

statement.en: Make a landscape-only iOS experience work equally well in both rotation directions.
statement.ja: landscape-onlyのiOS体験を左右どちらのrotation directionでも同等に動作させる。

conditions: The iOS app or game supports only landscape orientation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0026.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive within its landscape-only condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0027.title: Fit a necessary full-width iOS button to hardware and safe areas

statement.en: Make a necessary full-width iOS button harmonize with hardware curvature and adjacent safe areas.
statement.ja: 必要なfull-width iOS buttonをhardware curvatureと隣接safe areaに調和させる。

conditions: A full-width button is necessary despite the general guidance to avoid it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0027.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive without removing the full-width-button exception condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0030.title: Minimize unexpected UI changes while an iPadOS window resizes

statement.en: Minimize unexpected UI changes across the supported iPadOS window-size range.
statement.ja: 対応するiPadOS window-size range全体で予期しないUI変化を最小限にする。

conditions: A person resizes the window between its minimum and maximum supported sizes.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0030.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure directive and its resizing range.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0032.title: Prevent focused tvOS elements from covering important information

statement.en: Prevent focused tvOS elements from overlapping important information.
statement.ja: focusされたtvOS elementがimportant informationと重ならないようにする。

conditions: A focus effect enlarges the element.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0032.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive as a positive non-overlap requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0033.title: Prevent focused tvOS grid items from overlapping

statement.en: Space unfocused tvOS grid rows and columns to prevent overlap when an item receives focus.
statement.ja: itemがfocusされたとき重ならないよう、unfocusedなtvOS gridのrowとcolumnを配置する。

conditions: The interface uses a tvOS grid whose items enlarge on focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0033.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure directive for grid focus spacing.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0035.title: Provide enough space around visionOS interactive components

statement.en: Provide enough space around visionOS interactive components for comfortable visual identification and unobscured hover effects.
statement.ja: comfortableなvisual identificationとhover effectのため、visionOS interactive componentの周囲に十分なspaceを設ける。

conditions: Prevent the system hover effect from obscuring other content.
The source gives 60-point center spacing as an example, not an unconditional minimum.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0035.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit You need directive without promoting the 60-point example to a universal threshold.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0014.title: Match peripheral object brightness to surrounding content

statement.en: Match a moving peripheral object’s brightness to the rest of the visible content.
statement.ja: peripheral vision内のmoving objectのbrightnessを他のvisible contentに合わせる。

conditions: An immersive visionOS experience needs to show an object moving in peripheral vision.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0014.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive within its peripheral-motion exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0004.title: Use depth only when it adds value

statement.en: Use visionOS depth only where it clarifies, delights, or separates important content.
statement.ja: clarity、delight、important contentの分離に価値がある場合だけvisionOS depthを使う。

conditions: Prefer depth for large, important interface elements.
Review the frequency of depth changes because repeated refocusing can be tiring.
exceptions: Avoid depth that reduces legibility or usability on small objects.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0004.review_note: Retained MUST after reviewing the explicit Make sure lead and its value, scale, legibility, and refocusing limits.

additional_rules.title: Consider setting a custom dismissal time for an ended Live Activity

statement.en: Evaluate whether a custom dismissal time is appropriate after a Live Activity ends.
statement.ja: Live Activity終了後にカスタム消去時刻を設定することが適切か検討する。

conditions: The Live Activity has ended and retaining a short-lived summary may help people.

rationale.en: A proportional dismissal time can preserve a useful summary without keeping stale activity visible too long.
rationale.ja: 適切な消去時刻は、古い情報を長く残さずに有用な概要を一時的に保持できます。

additional_rules.review_note: Split from the source lead's consider clause so optional guidance is not raised to MUST.
